packageRules.description: Group WXT + Vite + Vitest together; WXT builds on Vite and Vitest tracks the same Vite line, so version skew breaks the build
Group eslint + plugins together; one bad version combo is the usual failure mode
Pin exact versions for npm and GitHub Actions only; other managers keep Renovate's default range strategy
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (security: tags can be moved)

Actions and pre-commit hooks are pinned as sha plus exact version tag, so a digest-only update means the tag was moved to another commit, which is the tampering case sha pinning exists to catch; release-age checks the tag original date and would not hold it, so require explicit dashboard approval. Initial pinning and version updates are unaffected

Docker registry lookups provide no release timestamp, so the release-age delay can never be satisfied and every image update would be held indefinitely; image updates remain human-reviewed on the weekly schedule

First-party library pinned to a reviewed commit and bumped deliberately alongside the change that needs it; the release-age delay is meaningless for our own code and the git-refs datasource has no release timestamp
The pre-commit hook resolves gitleaks from git tags, which carry no release timestamp for the release-age delay; resolve it from GitHub releases instead
Major version bumps need explicit review; never auto-merge
